articles.body:
## Milpitas Chapter Delivers 2,600 Garments to Sacred Heart

Our Milpitas chapter recently completed a major clothing drive and collected 2,600 total garments for community distribution.

That total represents an estimated $26,000 worth of clothing redirected back into the community instead of going to waste.

Volunteers sorted, packed, and prepared more than 50 bags of clothing before delivery. Every bag was sent to Sacred Heart in San Jose so the donations could quickly reach families and individuals who need them most.

This drive reflects what Garments4Goodness chapters do best: make sustainability practical, organize community action, and turn local support into immediate impact.

We are proud of the Milpitas team for the scale of this drive, the care that went into sorting and delivery, and the real support they created for Sacred Heart.

Thank you to everyone who donated, helped pack, and made the drive possible. Community generosity made this one count.
